options.reason: The table was clearly assembled for anemia classification: Result is the only two-level outcome (0/1) and the remaining columns are routine CBC indices, so a binary model with Result as the sole target matches the stated aim of comparing standard classifiers with calibration curves, a learning curve and SHAP attributions. Hemoglobin is flagged only as a suspect because a clinical anemia label is frequently defined by a hemoglobin cutoff, so it may recode the target; MCV, MCH and MCHC are derived red-cell indices of each other but are not recodings of Result. No row key, group or chronological column exists, so partitions need no grouping constraint.
options.title: binary
